oneLine: Runwal Enterprises eyes stronger balance sheet with a Rs 500-crore IPO

sources.title: Runwal Enterprises eyes stronger balance sheet with ₹500-crore IPO

synopsis: Mumbai-based real estate developer Runwal Enterprises is launching a Rs 500-crore initial public offering (IPO), which opens on September 25 and closes on September 29, 2026. The IPO consists entirely of a fresh issue with a price band ranging from Rs 290 to Rs 305 per equity share, valuing the company at around Rs 4,507.6 crore at the top of the price band. Subodh Runwal serves as the chairman and managing director of Runwal Enterprises. The company plans to use the IPO proceeds to repay or prepay certain outstanding borrowings, invest in wholly owned material subsidiaries for debt repayment, fund future real estate project acquisitions, and for general corporate purposes.
